title: Update Compose Py and Engine to Match Js
description: Update compose/py and compose/engine to be up-to-date with compose/js as reference. Get all tests passing and MCP server running.
summary:
Updated compose/py and compose/engine to be up-to-date with compose/js reference implementation. All tests passing (py: 9/9, engine: 42/42, js: 10/10) and MCP server running on all endpoints (REST /api, GraphQL /graphql, MCP /mcp).

Key changes:
1. engine/test.ts: Changed `poetry run pytest` to `uv run pytest` (poetry no longer used)
2. engine/pyproject.toml: Updated tox config from poetry to uv commands
3. py/compose.py: Made Side.connector optional to match JS SideSchema
4. py/compose.py: Updated SideNode/SideInputNode GraphQL types for optional connector
5. py/compose.py: Fixed Connection.parse and Connection.idMembers for optional connector
6. py/compose.py: Made connector_guid nullable in SQLite DDL
7. py/compose.py: Fixed SQLite export to extract GUIDs from nested dict references using _getGuidFromRef() for piece, connector, designPiece, type, design, parent, location, activeLayer fields
